details: Bitcoin experienced a quick pullback in U.S. morning trade, slipping 2% after failing to breach strong resistance above $75,000. It is now trading over 1% lower in the past 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin Slides Below $74K as Breakout Fails

details: Bitcoin's funding rates have dropped to their lowest levels since 2023, indicating substantial short positioning in the market. Historically, such deeply negative rates have often coincided with local market bottoms, hinting at a potential upward price squeeze.
title: Bitcoin Funding Rates Most Negative Since 2023, Suggesting Bottom

details: Solana-based DeFi platform Drift Protocol has secured up to $147.5 million in funding from Tether and its partners. This capital injection aims to facilitate user fund recovery and enable a relaunch of the protocol, following an April 1st exploit that resulted in over $270 million in compromised assets. Drift will transition to using USDT as its primary settlement layer, moving away from Circle's USDC.
title: Drift Protocol Gets $148M Funding from Tether, Shifts to USDT

details: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, is facing a class-action lawsuit from investors of Drift Protocol. The lawsuit alleges that Circle failed to act swiftly to freeze stolen USDC funds following the $280 million exploit, despite possessing the technical and contractual authority to do so.
title: Circle Sued Over Alleged Inaction in $280M Drift Exploit

details: Bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies saw approximately a 2% decline after U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance announced the failure of negotiations between U.S. and Iranian representatives to agree on an extended ceasefire.
title: US-Iran Talks Fail, Crypto Prices Fall

details: Charles Schwab has initiated a phased rollout of its spot cryptocurrency trading services for retail clients, providing direct access to Bitcoin and Ethereum. The new "Schwab Crypto" service will also offer educational resources and a transaction fee of 75 basis points.
title: Charles Schwab Launches Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading

details: XRP has experienced a price breakout, fueled by increasing institutional ETF inflows and heightened demand in derivatives markets. A surge in XRP futures Open Interest suggests growing leverage and investor anticipation for potential upside.
title: XRP Breaks Out Amid ETF Inflows & Derivatives Demand

details: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has introduced new guidance that could significantly expand the definition of crypto custody. Firms holding client assets for over 24 hours during settlement may now be classified as regulated custodians, necessitating a formal safeguarding license.
title: UK's New Crypto Rules Could Catch Firms Off Guard

details: Tether has announced the engagement of a "Big Four" accounting firm to conduct its first full financial statement audit of the reserves backing its $184 billion USDT stablecoin. This initiative aims to address long-standing transparency concerns and establish new disclosure standards.
title: Tether Hires 'Big Four' Firm for USDT Audit

details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) collectively saw an inflow of $186.03 million, with Blackrock's IBIT contributing a significant $291.86 million in concentrated inflows. This surge played a role in a broader rally across the crypto market, despite some outflows from other funds.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Add $186M Amidst Broad Market Rally
